protocol.purpose: Bounded independent-source CPU screen of quality-guided video processing for a speaker-evidence agent
protocol.selection: First two sources by archive size/name with both earliest eligible speaking and silent 25-frame tracks; exclude all seven previously evaluated sources; minimum native side 32. Select before inference.
protocol.restorer: Official FastDVDnet model_clipped_noise.pth, CPU, five frames; true sigma and fixed sigma55 settings
protocol.primary_screen: At least two independent sources with a BRISQUE/MUSIQ agreed restoration increasing speaker error by >=1/24, plus any restoration reducing error in at least one source.
protocol.guard: Use MUSIQ winner unless >0.1 of its binary speaker decisions disagree with captured input; otherwise retain captured. Fixed, untrained baseline, not proposed novel method.
protocol.agent: Qwen via Groq; bounded tools over cached real model outputs. No labels, source IDs, reference images, reference metrics or oracle outcomes in model context. Maximum 8 calls and 2048 output tokens per call per case.
protocol.scope: Descriptive pilot; no human quality judgment, calibrated confidence, audio-conditioned restoration, novel assessor validation or full quotation task. No outcome-dependent sample replacement. Report all cases.
